title: Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Malicious adversaries can employ gradient inversion attacks to reverse-engineer private data using the model updates of a round in Federated Learning. While there have been developments in gradient inversion for text, exact text recovery by a malicious client has so far remained infeasible, as FedAvg entangles the gradient contributions of many clients and obscures the signal of any individual sentence. We introduce a novel attack pipeline that unwinds this entanglement progressively through an iterative loop, in which the gradient contributions of sentences recovered exactly in one round are subtracted from the aggregate, exposing the remaining sentences for recovery in the next iteration. We show, for the first time, exact sentence recovery, with 100% precision, and on aggregates containing up to $4\times$ more tokens than the model's hidden dimension, we recover up to 80.2% of client sentences exactly, a regime where existing attacks

translated_title: 在联邦学习过程中从其他客户端窃取精确训练数据
translated_abstract: 恶意攻击者可以利用梯度反演攻击，借助联邦学习中某一轮的模型更新来逆向还原隐私数据。尽管针对文本的梯度反演技术已有诸多进展，但迄今为止，恶意客户端实现对文本的精确还原仍不可行，因为FedAvg将多个客户端的梯度贡献纠缠在一起，掩盖了任何单个句子的信号。我们提出了一种新颖的攻击流水线，通过迭代循环逐步解开这种纠缠：在每一轮迭代中，将已精确还原的句子的梯度贡献从聚合梯度中减去，从而使剩余的句子暴露出来以便在下一轮迭代中被还原。我们首次实现了100%精度的句子精确还原，并且在包含多达模型隐藏维度4倍令牌数的聚合数据上，精确还原了高达80.2%的客户端句子——这是现有攻击无法企及的领域。
tldr: 该论文首次提出一种迭代式攻击流水线，通过逐轮从聚合梯度中减去已还原句子的梯度贡献来解开FedAvg的多客户端梯度纠缠，实现了联邦学习中100%精度的文本精确还原，最高可精确还原80.2%的客户端句子。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel iterative attack pipeline that progressively unwinds the gradient entanglement in FedAvg by subtracting the contributions of exactly recovered sentences each round, achieving for the first time exact text recovery with 100% precision in federated learning, recovering up to 80.2% of client sentences.
